parameters.query:
SELECT  id_story, act_number, chapter
FROM story_acts 
WHERE id_story = '{{ $('prepare_items').item.json.id_story }}' 
ORDER BY act_number ASC;

INSERT INTO story_acts
(
id_story,
act_number,
arc_phase,
chapter,
summary,
memory
)
VALUES
(
'{{ $json.id_story }}',
{{ $json.act_number }},
'{{ $json.arc_phase }}',
'{{ $json.chapter }}',
'{{ $json.summary }}',
'{{ $json.memory }}'
);

INSERT INTO stories (
  id_story,
  story_name,
  total_acts,
  created_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.id_story }}',
  '{{ $json.story_name }}',
  {{ $json.total_acts }},
  now()
)
ON CONFLICT (id_story) DO NOTHING
RETURNING *;
